info.title: KarryGo Vendor Service — Section 8G: Corporate Customer CRM
info.description:
Vendor-local commercial relationships with organizations: corporate accounts, lifecycle, branch scope, contacts linked to Section 8A customer relationships, memberships, locations, cost centres, and corporate interactions and tasks reusing the Section 8C engine.

Scope boundary. Section 8G describes WHO the vendor deals with. It holds no corporate orders, invoices, credit, budgets, wallets, contracts, quotations, catalogue entitlements, scoring or exports, and it publishes no route, schema or state that could describe one. Money remains payment-wallet-service's authority and customer contact details remain Section 8A's; a contact here is an opaque reference plus a non-identifying label, never an address book entry.

All routes are mounted under the authenticated vendor base path and are tenant-scoped from the session. There are no internal routes: corporate contact privacy and identity merge are handled through the existing Section 8A event ingress and its PrivacyHandler port.

CostCenterId.name: costCenterId
CostCenterId.description: Cost centre reference within this account.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every command. Replaying a key returns the original response; reusing it with a different body is CRM_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

CorporateStatus.description: Relationship lifecycle. It describes the commercial relationship, never a commercial document: there is no ordered, invoiced or credit-suspended state here, because Vendor Service Section 8G holds no orders, invoices, credit or budgets.

CorporateScopeMode.description: BUSINESS makes the account visible to every branch of the vendor. BRANCH_SET restricts it to an explicit branch list, and a branch-scoped operator sees only accounts covering a branch they hold.

CorporateMembershipRole.description: A membership role is a CRM label describing how a person participates in the organization's dealings with this vendor. It grants no authority: APPROVER does not approve anything, because Section 8G runs no approval workflow.

corporate_ref.description: Opaque vendor-local identifier for the corporate account.

corporate_customer_code.description: Human-quotable vendor-local reference, CORP-<digits>. It is allocated per vendor and is not a platform-wide identifier.

account_manager_staff_ref.description: Vendor staff reference. Must be an active staff member of this vendor.

external_organization_ref.description: Vendor's own reference for the organization in another system. Unique per vendor when present.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. Send it back as expected_version on the next write.

CorporateSummary.description: Counts of what an operator can act on: archived children and privacy-suppressed contacts are excluded.

branch_refs.description: Required when scope_mode is BRANCH_SET; every branch must belong to this vendor and to the caller's own scope.

clear_account_manager.description: Update only. Removes the account manager.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. Send it back as expected_version on the next write.

customer_profile_ref.description: Reference to the Section 8A customer relationship. Contact details themselves are never duplicated here and are never returned by this section.

display_label.description: Non-identifying label resolved from the Section 8A profile at read time. Null whenever the relationship is privacy-suppressed.

privacy_suppressed.description: True once the underlying customer relationship has been redacted. The link is kept for continuity; the person is not addressable through it.

actionable.description: False when the contact is archived or privacy-suppressed. It is the only signal a caller should act on.

CorporateCostCenter.description: A cost centre is a CRM label used to organise an organization's dealings with this vendor. It carries no budget, limit, currency or balance: Section 8G is not a financial authority, and payment-wallet-service remains the only one.
